description: Synthetic, secret-free example showing a scanner-based GO/NO-GO evidence bundle. Demonstrates deterministic scan profile, redacted artifact bundle, log retention boundaries, artifact hygiene assertions, and no-live/no-secret safety markers. No Docker, live broker, or GitHub writes required.

preExecutionChecklist: 1. Verify backup of runner rootDir has been taken and validated.
2. Review all HIGH-risk entries manually before proceeding.
3. Confirm no active runs are in-progress for any candidate safeTaskId.
4. Obtain explicit operator approval token before executing any mutation.
5. Execute only against staging/test rootDir, not production.
6. Keep audit log of every removed directory with before/after evidence.
cleanupDryRunPlan.rollbackNotes: Rollback requires restoring from backup taken before cleanup execution. Individual run directories can be restored from backup by safeTaskId/runToken path. If the backup was not verified before execution, rollback is not guaranteed. Abort by stopping the cleanup process before the approval token is consumed.

logRetentionBoundary.assertion: All command logs are bounded at 8,000 chars with truncated marker
logRetentionBoundary.testRef: artifact hygiene: createArtifactBundle truncates oversized files at log retention boundary

noHostPathLeakage.assertion: No /tmp/, /home/, /root/ paths in bundle artifact content
noHostPathLeakage.testRef: artifact hygiene: bundle never leaks host paths in artifact content

validManifestEntries.assertion: Every artifacts[] entry has non-empty name, valid path, non-negative size
validManifestEntries.testRef: artifact hygiene: bundle manifest entries have valid names and sizes

deterministicBaseFields.testRef: artifact hygiene: bundle manifest has safe generatedAt and no overflow status

riskNotes: No production deploy, restart, or live service mutation performed.
All changes are source/docs/tests only — no worker restart, no DB mutation.
New tests verify artifact hygiene invariants (log retention boundary, path safety, valid entries, deterministic base fields).
Docs update adds GO/NO-GO hygiene assertions reference table to scanner.md.
Example is self-contained, synthetic, and secret-free.
approvalSensitiveBlockers: OpenClaw runtime/bootstrap context files (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, USER.md, TOOLS.md, HEARTBEAT.md, IDENTITY.md, .openclaw/**) must not enter branch. `.gitignore` blocks these; pre-pr-bootstrap-guard.mjs also fails closed.
